title: Qualcomm says it has signed a 10-year deal to supply chips for BMW's future digital cockpit and advanced driver-assistance systems (Harshita Mary Varghese/Reuters)
summary: Harshita Mary Varghese / Reuters: Qualcomm says it has signed a 10-year deal to supply chips for BMW's future digital cockpit and advanced driver-assistance systems — Qualcomm (QCOM.O) said on Wednesday it has signed a long-term deal to supply chips for German luxury automaker BMW's (BMWG.DE) future digital cockpit …
